title: Hearty Norwegian Fish Poke
description: A briny and gooey Norwegian dish featuring oranges and pickle, perfect for pescatarians, this recipe is a quick fix for a delicious meal.
instructions: Cut the cod fillets into small cubes and place them in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the lemon juice mixture over the cod cubes and toss to coat.
Add the orange segments, pickle relish, red onion, and chopped fresh dill to the bowl with the cod.
Gently toss all the ingredients together until they are well combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, sprinkle the toasted almonds over the top of the fish mixture.
Serve the Hearty Norwegian Fish Poke chilled, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
